title: Photo Equipment Technician
description:
About Samsung Austin Semiconductor
Samsung is a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, founded on the belief that the pursuit of excellence creates a better world. At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, we are Innovating Today to Power the Devices of Tomorrow. 

Come innovate with us!

Position Summary

In your role as a Photo Equipment Technician you’ll be responsible for performing functions associated with all manufacturing and/or system operations, such as working with engineers and manufacturing in set-up and calibration tasks, system support, preventative maintenance, failure analysis, documenting/following standard operating procedures, as well as performing maintenance and quality testing related to the photolithography equipment. Uses sophisticated programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct in-line adjustments, flow adjustments, and mechanical repairs. Requires compliance with all health, safety and environmental management system guidelines.

Role and Responsibilities

Here's what you'll be responsible for:

  • A safety and quality centered mindset. Proficiency with basic hand tools. Experience or knowledge of the photolithography process is a plus.

  • Troubleshooting: Data analysis and hardware failure analysis/repair in a high-pressure atmosphere. Utilization of onboard diagnostics to understand and correct equipment issues. Thorough documentation of all repairs and maintenance. 

  • Monitor Equipment/Process: Monitoring equipment and processes in current state and proactively looks for ways to improve processes.

  • Teamwork and Communication: Working in a team environment and effectively communicate throughout organization.

Skills and Qualifications

Here's what you'll need:

  • Associates degree or other technical certification. Mechanical experience or computer-based troubleshooting experience.

  • 4 years equivalent relevant technical and/or Military service.

  • Familiarity with 6S best practices. 

  • Familiar with TBM concepts.

  • Focused on continuous improvement in fast-paced, changing environment.

The current base salary range for this role is between $18.60 - $45.00/hour. Individual base pay rates will depend on factors including duties, work location, education, skills, qualifications and experience. Total compensation for this position will include a competitive benefits package and may include participation in company incentive compensation programs, which are based on factors to include organizational and individual performance.

Total Rewards
At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, base pay is just one part of our total compensation package. The base compensation for this role will depend on education, experience, skills, and location.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Life insurance and 401(k) matching with immediate vesting

  • Onsite café(s) and workout facilities

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • Paid time off (PTO) + 2 personal holidays and 10 regular holidays

  • Wellness incentives and MORE
     

Eligible full-time employees (salaried or hourly) may also receive MBO bonuses based on company, division, and individual performance.

All positions at Samsung Austin Semiconductor are full-time on-site.
